newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: YHS sees gains from property in 1997.
newsitem.headline: YHS sees gains from property in 1997.

text.p: Soft drinks firm Yeo Hiap Seng (YHS) said on Tuesday it expected a positive contribution to its results in 1997 from sales from property. The company said in a statement issued with its 1996 results it would pursue its strategy of regional expansion and consolidation of its Singapore operations.
"The food and beverage business is not expected to show immediate significant improvement. Property development projects which the group has embarked on are currently on stream," the statement said.
